FROM THE RAIL TO YOUR REQUEST

Choose. Request.
Let’s confirm it.

Your cart starts a conversation.
Our team confirms the details.

01

Work your way along

Browse a rack for each meat type. Slide the hangers or use the arrows, then select a cut to bring it forward.

02

Choose your quantity

Add requested weights to your cart, then share delivery and preparation preferences.

03

Confirm with the team

Review and send the request. We confirm availability, actual weight, pricing and delivery before an order is agreed.
